tracklet_id.description: Per-camera track ID from ByteTrack. Stable within one camera only.

ts.description: UTC, microsecond precision. Stamped by the gateway's NTP-disciplined clock, NEVER the camera RTC — legacy DVR clocks drift minutes per week and a reversed timestamp corrupts the whole trajectory.

class.description: auto_rickshaw is not a COCO class and must be added by fine-tuning; it is a large share of Indian traffic.

bbox.description: [x, y, w, h] in SOURCE pixels, not resized-model pixels.

text.description: Raw OCR output, uppercased, punctuation stripped.

char_confs.description: Per-character confidence. Lets the matcher weight a fuzzy match by WHICH character is uncertain.

valid_fmt.description: Passed Indian plate grammar + valid state code.

width_px.description: Below ~90px, treat the read as unreliable regardless of conf.

geo.description: Present only when the camera is calibrated (homography set).

score.description: Composite gate score; drives whether ANPR ran at all.

clock_confidence.description: 0-1. Low values widen the matcher's spatio-temporal gate instead of producing a false negative.

crop_key.description: Object key of the vehicle crop. NOT the image itself.
